title: A Claude Code workflow's journal is exported as a session of its own
foundBy: session agent, while exporting a Claude Code 2.1.312 session that ran a workflow of 83 agents
details:
Claude Code stores a workflow's agents under `<session>/subagents/workflows/<runId>/`, beside a `journal.jsonl` that records each agent starting and returning. Discovery reads that journal as a transcript. It becomes a root trajectory named `unknown-session`, with one unrecognized `meta` event per journal line.

In the session that found it, the journal added a 167-event trajectory to an index of 85 real ones. Nothing marks it as anything other than a session. The journal is the workflow's own bookkeeping, not a conversation, so it should not reach the index.
